notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Pełna lista zmian:


 Shoutouts to Joaquín Masimelli for translating the game into Latin American Spanish!
 Fixed a bug where merging a crate goal block could cause the level to freeze
 For better clarity, the quantum tesseract goal now collapses when the player is inside it
 Added more bugs to fix later

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
Full change log:


 Fixed collapses counter
 Fixed glue used counter
 Fixed parallel realities counter
 Improved behaviour of crates placed on quantum crate goals
 Added more bugs to fix later

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2
notes.content:
Full change log:


 Normalized the volumes of the OST
 The basic controls prompt, which appears after a period of inactivity, now takes longer to show up after completing 15+ levels
 Changed third star for completing level "Snake" to "Switches used ≤ 9"
 Prevented the "Predicament" level from automatically merging for better clarity
 Enchanced perfomance by removing unnecessary objects from blocks prefabs
 Fixed glue logic
 Fixed crates and crate goals interactions in quantum and inverted states
 Added more bugs to fix later

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
Full change log:


 Fixed a bug that made it possible to put quantum crate on quantum crate goal without collapse
 Added 2 missing localization strings
 Fixed problems with collecting quantum star bits
 Fixed weird behaviour of "New record" and "Your best" in level completion window
 Fixed best scores tracking
 Reduced unnecessary snapping of mouse cursor to center of screen if gamepad is not in use
